dominant_strengths: Bold sans headline anchored in a white card creates strong visceral focus against busy carousel of community work samples.
Carousel showcases Figma's range through real artifacts, signaling craft and creative breadth without verbose copy.
Clean nav hierarchy with consistent CTA treatment (Contact sales outline, Get started filled) reads as native and trustworthy.
dominant_weaknesses: Carousel tiles clash chromatically — neon green, electric yellow, and rainbow swirl fight the headline card for attention.
Indigo 'Get started' button inside the white card conflicts with the black 'Get started for free' nav CTA, weakening system color logic.
Headline card floats awkwardly mid-canvas, occluding key carousel imagery and creating muddled z-axis composition.
fix_priorities: Unify primary CTA color across nav and hero to remove dual-brand-blue tension.
Dim or desaturate carousel tiles behind the headline card so the type reads as figure, not noise.
Reposition or scale the headline card so it doesn't bisect the most expressive showcase tiles.
Tighten supporting subcopy spacing under the carousel to rebalance vertical rhythm.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral punch from the carousel slightly overpowers behavioral clarity, while reflective meaning (Figma as creative platform) lands well via real work samples.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it communicates Figma's expanded multi-product creative surface through community artifacts, though the executional polish lags the ambition.
